arguments.content:
# LAMMPS Input Script for Magnesium NVT Equilibration

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/melting/workflow/subtasks/magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_melting_trial_2/magnesium_structure.data

# Replicate the unit cell
replicate 5 5 5

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

# Define settings for NVT ensemble
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe etotal press vol

# Set up the NVT ensemble
fix 1 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1

# Run the simulation
run 10000

# Write the final structure to a file
write_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/melting/workflow/subtasks/magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_2/equilibrated_structure.data
